prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: final opaque production UI sprite atlas for large, readable image-based controls in a friendly premium sci-fi memory game.
Primary request: Create ONE final image, EXACTLY 1536 x 1024 pixels, with exactly THREE columns and TWO rows of equal invisible SQUARE cells, each 512 x 512 pixels. Exactly SIX circular metallic control discs, one centered in each cell.
Scene/backdrop: Completely solid, uniform deep navy #0c2231 (RGB 12,34,49) throughout the entire background and every cell. Fully opaque PNG. No transparency, checkerboard, background gradient, vignette, texture, scene or ground plane. No grid lines or cell separators.
Precise composition: The six cell centers are (256,256), (768,256), (1280,256), (256,768), (768,768), and (1280,768). Each disc has an IDENTICAL outer diameter approximately 68% of its 512-pixel cell, about 348 pixels. Center all discs exactly. Keep each complete silhouette comfortably inside its cell with generous empty navy margins. All discs use exactly the same circular outer rim, depth and size.
Camera and materials: Perfectly FRONT-ON view. All disc faces are parallel to the image plane. Thick brushed titanium and navy circular rims, soft substantial metal bevels, convincing tactile depth, subtle object-surface shadows and clean studio highlights. Cyan or amber inset illumination, polished premium friendly 3D game-item rendering. Restrained surface detail. Keep all dimensional shading on the objects so the background remains a uniform flat navy.
Strict symbols in row-major order:
TOP LEFT: MINUS — one enormous luminous cyan HORIZONTAL BAR.
TOP MIDDLE: PLUS — one enormous luminous cyan CROSS with equal horizontal and vertical strokes.
TOP RIGHT: INFINITY — one enormous luminous cyan HORIZONTAL FIGURE-EIGHT, a single continuous clearly recognizable infinity symbol.
BOTTOM LEFT: CLOCK — enormous luminous cyan CLOCK HANDS on the dark disc face, with a clear center pivot and two hands of different lengths, one pointing toward twelve and one toward three; instantly recognizable as a clock, no numerals.
BOTTOM MIDDLE: RETRY — one enormous raised luminous AMBER CIRCULAR ARROW, a clean clockwise circular stroke with ONE clear arrowhead.
BOTTOM RIGHT: SKIP — TWO enormous raised luminous CYAN RIGHT-FACING CHEVRONS, side by side, unmistakably pointing right.
Symbol treatment: Each symbol is the only feature inside its disc face. Symbols must be huge, clean, high contrast and instantly readable in a 44-pixel button. Thick luminous sculpted strokes, simple silhouettes, no tiny detail. No additional badges, ornament, glyphs, buttons or icons.
Constraints: Exactly six discs and exactly the six specified symbols, in the exact specified positions. No labels, words, letters, numbers, titles, logos, watermarks, UI mockup, borders around cells, dividers or extra objects. Do not create a station scene. ONE final original companion UI asset, no variants.
notes: All six requested symbols are present in order. Bright-bound estimates are read-only contrast measurements, not exact segmentation. Disc diameter and bottom-row centers differ somewhat from the requested dimensions; background is navy with slight pixel variation.
